name: lore
tagline_zh: 把散落的AI编程会话挖成矿，自动提炼可复现的工作流，一键铸成技能装进所有Agent。别家没有的：跨工具证据链。
tagline_en: Mine scattered AI coding sessions into a persistent corpus, surface reproducible workflows, and forge them into.
desc_en: SpecStory Lore - mine your SpecStory coding histories (any agent - Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini, and more) into a persistent corpus, surface your reproducible workflows with corroborated evidence, and interactively forge the chosen ones into skills installed across all your agent harnesses. Use when the user wants to turn past AI coding sessions into reusable skills, asks "what could I make
why_zh: 同类只会总结单次对话，它用多源历史交叉验证，提炼出的技能有据可查，装进所有Agent无缝复用。
why_en: Unlike tools that summarize one chat, it cross-validates across histories, producing evidence-backed skills that install.
